measurement: unique contact-intent visitors divided by unique exposed contact-page visitors
assumption_note: Planning assumptions, not measured ArcSage rates. Review before public enrolment; record any change as a new experiment version.
stopping_rule: Collect at least the fixed per-arm target and two full weeks; do not stop based on observed outcome p-values.
outcome_limits: A contact-intent click is not delivered email, a qualified enquiry, a sale, or increased AI search exposure.
